question.text: What does 'Ongoing Due Diligence' mean in the context of AML/CFT compliance?

answer.text: Continuous monitoring of transactions and periodic updating of customer information throughout the business relationship
Conducting a one-time thorough investigation of the customer at the time of account opening
Performing due diligence only when a suspicious transaction is detected
Reviewing customer records only during regulatory audits or inspections

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 48 and 79 require ongoing scrutiny of transactions throughout the business relationship and consistency with the customer's knowledge, risk profile, and source of funds, while page 80 requires periodic updates to customer information. The Trap: A one-time investigation at account opening is initial CDD, not ongoing due diligence. ODD is a continuous process throughout the business relationship. Note: The source framing covers ongoing transaction scrutiny and periodic updates; specific automated alerts and broader cross-exam practices are not stated in the checked pages.
